parameters.name: groupName
parameters.description: The name of the machine group. This parameter is used to filter machine groups. Partial match is supported.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: The line from which the query starts. Default value: 0.

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: The number of entries per page. Maximum value: 500.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun sls list-machine-group --project ali-test-project --offset 1 --size 10 --group-name test-machine-group --region cn-hangzhou
